text:
Situation: Nitroglycerin 0.4 mg tablets have been on FDA's shortage list with status To Be Discontinued since 2023-10-06, a period of 37 months as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 74 tablets at 13.2 per day (5.6 days on hand). Corvale General holds 198 tablets at 14.2 per day (14 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 24 tablets at 3.8 per day (6.3 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows nitroglycerin with status To Be Discontinued and an initial posting date of 2023-10-06.

Our position: Current inventory across three sites provides between 5.6 and 14 days of supply. A rule-based check finds FDA actions or weak links but no action before a posting at a registered plant, or some records fail data checks; the buyer should verify current supply agreements and inspection histories for the labeled plants. The best option by rule is to buy from Advagen Pharma Ltd., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to verify supply agreements and inspection histories for labeled plants and present findings to P&T Committee for approval.
2. Buyer to initiate purchase from Advagen Pharma Ltd. pending P&T Committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Aurobindo Pharma Limited, Dr. Reddys Laboratories Inc., Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA, and HF Acquisition Co LLC as secondary sources pending P&T Committee approval.

Not recommended: No changes to clinical protocols or dosing; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
